pages.text: A plain ruin is centered on its own block layer and influences an exact 13×1×13 area: six blocks in each horizontal direction and only the one-block Y layer. Non-player creatures are attracted or repelled according to its current state; players are included when player influence is enabled. A player holding a Miniature Immortal Ruin in the main or off hand is always excluded. Sneak-use with an empty hand toggles attraction/repulsion; sneak-use with the Spirit Staff wrench picks it up. Wrench-link opposite states, then enable Warp on the attracting end for one-way transfer from the ruin's center block.

The Stabilized version has 54 slots plus area, frequency, preview, enabled, six-face interaction, and 20-slot whitelist/blacklist controls. Normal mode collects drops; reversed mode ejects to air or an item handler. Linked opposite ends share one inventory.

The Entangled Stabilized version runs its normal and reversed sides in parallel every tick over one shared 54-slot buffer. Each side has independent range, frequency, preview, enabled, face mask, and 20-slot filter settings; switch the configured side with the left/right arrows.

The Advanced Stabilized version is an independent 54-slot container and is not Xianqiao-bound. Normal mode pulls one acceptable stack per in-range container; reversed mode distributes its inventory across those containers. Unaccepted remainder stays inside instead of becoming a world drop.

The Advanced Entangled version combines two independent advanced schedules over one shared 54-slot buffer and can also be converted from the Advanced Stabilized version. Normal and reversed sides configure their filters, range, frequency, preview, enabled switch, and face masks separately.

Advanced scheduling offers access (poll-skip/force-poll), split (item-by-item/group-by-group), and order (far-first/near-first). The scanned area exactly matches the preview box. Every in-range position times every enabled face is a separate target; all faces off disables container interaction for that side. Settings and filter panels are mutually exclusive.
